subject_rule: Not a fixed list: 'Applicants should apply for the field of study they majored in at university or its related field(s)', the field must be one that can be studied and researched in graduate courses at Japanese universities, and 'the fields of study may be restricted to the particular fields specified by the Japanese Embassy or Consulate' in the applicant's country; Kabuki and classical Japanese dance and subjects needing practical training at factories or companies are not included.
notes: The guidelines, application form, placement form and study-plan form contain no catalogue of majors or programmes: the field and the Japanese university (up to three) are entered freely by the applicant. No programme rows are recorded.
Any restriction to particular fields is set per country by the Japanese embassy or consulate in that country's own call; this was not read for every country.
Students of medicine, dentistry or welfare science may not do clinical training until licensed under Japanese law (guidelines, section 2).
any_subject is deliberately left unset: the guidelines say 'major or related field', not 'any subject', and allow embassy restrictions.
not_stated: A list of fields or graduate programmes
